valuation.method: Forward non-GAAP EPS x P/E (FY2028E non-GAAP diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date in November 2027)

bear.driver: Pharmaceutical distribution margin compression and slower specialty growth

base.driver: Steady Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions growth plus ASR share count reduction

bull.driver: Outperformance in specialty pharma, GLP-1/biopharma volume, and accelerated buybacks

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2028E EPS of $14.34, the $281.10 close implies 19.6x; at 21.0x, the close implies $13.39 EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $14.34 (5.1 pp of return).
valuation.watch_metric: Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions segment profit growth and FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS ($12.80-$13.00 guidance)

analyst_notes: Following Q1 FY2027 results on November 5, 2026 (non-GAAP EPS $3.26, +28% YoY, and FY2027 guidance raised to $12.80-$13.00), TD Cowen, Evercore ISI, and JPMorgan raised targets into a $286-$320 range. Post-cutoff raises (e.g., Barclays to $320 on November 18) are excluded. Our $301.00 base case (+7.1% upside) sits near the $300-$304 Street consensus, reflecting ~11% FY2028E EPS growth at 21.0x.
